text:
Alex: FYI opened a PR to change the audit schema — proposing actor.source, auth_context (id,method), canonical_session_id, and event.impact_score. Need quick reviews for customer-facing validation and backfill implications. PR: <https://git.internal/redwood/audit-schema/pulls/412>
Priya: quick q — how are we handling historical logs? customers will expect those fields for compliance reporting.
Alex: plan is best-effort backfill: transform when we can, otherwise set _legacy: true and include mapping metadata so customers can filter. Documenting per-customer backfill window in the changelog.
Jordan: KMS question — auth_context must not contain any raw KMS material. We'll only store key_id and method, all secrets redacted. Eng-Security signoff required before backfill runs.
Maya: for incident reconstruction, we need stable identifiers: canonical_user_id + canonical_session_id + request_id. Is request_id stable across retries?
Alex: yes, request_id is the idempotent UUID we attach at the edge. canonical_session_id will be populated for interactive sessions; for batch jobs it will be null.
Priya: customers asked for a validation tool so they can verify their ingestion pipelines. Can we expose a /audit/validate endpoint that accepts a sample event and returns pass/fail + human-readable reasons?
Jordan: OK but rate-limit that endpoint and require an API token scope (audit:validate). Also return a header X-Audit-Schema: v2.0 so clients can detect schema version.
Alex: sample event to validate (example):
```json
{
  "timestamp": "2026-03-07T14:12:03Z",
  "event_type": "token.create",
  "actor": { "id": "u_12345", "source": "console" },
  "auth_context": { "method": "oauth", "key_id": "key-prod-9" },
  "request_id": "req-9f8b7c6a",
  "canonical_session_id": "sess-20260307-7adf",
  "event": { "description": "created API token", "impact_score": 12, "impact_source": "heuristic-v1" }
}
```
Priya: that looks good. For backfill I'd like per-customer jobs and a progress topic so we can resume/retry if it fails. Suggest writing progress to customer_metadata.audit_backfill.{customer_id}.
Devops-bot: audit-backfill job queued: audit-backfill/1768302468, est runtime 2h, priority: medium.
Maya: regarding impact_score — we need a deterministic numeric 0-100 and provenance (impact_source) so customers and SRE can trust it. How are we calculating it?
Alex: initial plan: heuristic rules based on auth method, resource sensitivity, and action type. We'll include impact_source and rule_id so it's reproducible. Will add unit tests.
Sasha: (security) I'll review the PR this afternoon. One reminder: Private deployments cannot run automatic DB migrations, so we need an opt-in flag for backfill or provide a migration bundle customers can apply.
Priya: agree — add an opt-in backfill flag per deployment and a downloadable backfill artifact for air-gapped installs.
Alex: will update the PR with: opt-in flag, /audit/validate endpoint, sample payloads, backfill job plan, and changelog notes for Private. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Jordan: optional: include a small test harness that takes a list of sample events and emits a compatibility report customers can run locally.
Alex: added unit tests + the harness to the PR, link updated: <https://git.internal/redwood/audit-schema/pulls/412>
Priya: can someone add a short note for support about how to answer customer questions on legacy events?
Maya: I'll draft a KB with example queries for timeline reconstruction (joins on request_id + session_id) and share later.
Sasha: Security ack pending after I check KMS redaction logic.
Alex: great — will wait for final ack before scheduling the customer backfill window. Thanks everyone.
